palette.name: blue
palette.role: The brand blue: large fills, illustrations, logos. Too light for text of either ink at 4.5:1.

palette.name: deep blue
palette.role: The brand blue darkened until white text on it reads at 4.5:1: backgrounds and text on paper.

palette.name: yellow
palette.role: The pop accent: highlights and blocks, always with ink on it.

palette.name: white
palette.role: Clean background and text on deep blue.

palette.name: dark stone
palette.role: Quiet secondary text on yellow, where stone falls short of 4.5:1.

palette.name: tan
palette.role: Subdued: light tan blocks, and quiet text on dark sepia.

palette.name: sepia
palette.role: Subdued: dark sepia backgrounds and the shadows of its pictures.

palette.name: sepia ink
palette.role: Subdued: text on the sepia page, tan and ochre.

palette.name: ochre
palette.role: Subdued: the muted highlight, always with sepia ink on it.

palette.name: sepia stone
palette.role: Subdued: quiet secondary text on the sepia page and tan.

art.style: Flat, bold editorial illustration with simple shapes, generous space and one clear subject.
dos: Keep one clear subject and leave room for text.
Show students in everyday study and campus moments.
donts: Do not add text, letters or numbers to the image.
Do not use gradients, glow or glossy effects.
Do not copy a real person's likeness.

rules: Speak to every student, never down to them.
Use plain words, not jargon or marketing.
voice.readingLevel: Plain English that a 16-year-old reads without a dictionary.
